items_flat.title_en: Anthropic plans enterprise data-retention flexibility for frontier models
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 計畫為前沿模型提供企業資料保留彈性
items_flat.summary_en: According to Bloomberg and Reuters citing a person familiar, Anthropic will still require 30-day retention for safety monitoring on its most capable models but plans to let enterprise customers keep that data on their own cloud infrastructure. A new safety system is expected later this year after coordination with more than 100 customers including Salesforce.
items_flat.summary_zh: 據 Bloomberg 與 Reuters 引述知情人士，Anthropic 仍將要求最強力模型進行 30 天安全監控資料保留，但計畫允許企業客戶將資料存放在自家雲端基礎設施。新安全系統預計今年稍晚推出，已與包括 Salesforce 在內的逾 100 家客戶協調。
items_flat.analysis_en: This responds to enterprise pushback against the June 30-day retention mandate that conflicted with zero-retention expectations. It narrows the gap with OpenAI’s Private Safety Processing approach while keeping safety monitoring intact; exact technical controls and timeline remain unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉回應企業對 6 月 30 天保留規定的反彈，該規定與零保留期望衝突。它縮小了與 OpenAI Private Safety Processing 的差距，同時保留安全監控；具體技術控制與時程仍未確認。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing while reaffirming Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 Private Safety Processing，並重申前沿模型零資料保留
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will continue offering Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and is previewing Private Safety Processing. The system is designed to detect misuse patterns across related interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布將繼續為符合資格的 API 客戶提供零資料保留，並預覽 Private Safety Processing。該系統旨在偵測相關互動中的濫用模式，同時不讓 OpenAI 人員接觸底層內容。
items_flat.analysis_en: This directly addresses enterprise demand for stronger privacy as models handle longer autonomous work. It positions OpenAI differently from rivals requiring longer retention, though the practical effectiveness of the new safety layer remains to be proven in production.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉直接回應企業對更強隱私的需求，因模型開始處理更長時間的自主工作。它使 OpenAI 與要求較長保留期的對手有所區隔，但新安全層的實際生產效果仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: We will continue to offer Zero Data Retention for frontier models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將繼續為前沿模型提供零資料保留。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches AI Futures blog from new Strategic Futures team
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出由新 Strategic Futures 團隊撰寫的 AI Futures 部落格
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced the AI Futures blog, authored by Dean Ball of its new Strategic Futures team. The inaugural post focuses on how free societies should restructure to preserve individual rights and agency amid transformative AI, emphasizing institutional adaptation rather than pure technical fixes.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 AI Futures 部落格，由新成立的 Strategic Futures 團隊的 Dean Ball 撰寫。首篇文章聚焦自由社會應如何重組以在變革性 AI 中保有個人權利與自主權，強調制度適應而非純技術解方。
items_flat.analysis_en: This signals OpenAI is formalizing longer-horizon political-economy thinking inside the company. It remains an individual author’s view rather than an official corporate position, so its policy weight is still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示 OpenAI 正在公司內部正式化較長遠的政治經濟思考。目前仍屬個人作者觀點而非官方企業立場，政策影響力仍有限。
items_flat.quote: It is our pleasure to launch AI Futures, the blog of OpenAI’s new Strategic Futures team. We are a small team with the collective goal of answering one overarching question: how should free society be restructured to preserve individual rights and agency while accommodating the emergence of transformative AI?
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們很高興推出 AI Futures，這是 OpenAI 新成立的 Strategic Futures 團隊的部落格。我們是一個小團隊，共同目標是回答一個核心問題：自由社會應如何重組，才能在轉型式 AI 出現時仍保有個人權利與主體性？

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 已在 Amazon Bedrock 正式上線
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The model offers a 500k context window, configurable reasoning levels, and support for long-running agents plus interactive and visual work.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已在 Amazon Bedrock 正式可用。該模型提供 50 萬 token 上下文視窗、可配置推理等級，並支援長時間運行代理以及互動與視覺工作。
items_flat.analysis_en: Enterprise availability on Bedrock expands Grok’s reach beyond native platforms and Cursor. It strengthens SpaceXAI’s position in the agentic and coding market at a competitive price point, though differentiation versus other frontier models on Bedrock will depend on real workload performance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Bedrock 的企業可用性讓 Grok 的觸及範圍超越原生平台與 Cursor。這強化了 SpaceXAI 在代理與程式設計市場的地位與價格競爭力，但與 Bedrock 上其他前沿模型的差異仍取決於實際工作負載表現。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6 現已在 Amazon Bedrock 正式可用。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches native Mac app for Meta AI with system-wide dictation and screen context
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出原生 Mac 版 Meta AI App，支援系統級聽寫與螢幕脈絡
items_flat.summary_en: Meta released a native macOS beta app for Meta AI. It supports system-wide dictation, Quick Invoke, attaching Mac windows for context, and deeper integrations with Instagram, Facebook, Meta ads, and Google Workspace for business insights.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 釋出原生 macOS 測試版 Meta AI App。支援系統級聽寫、Quick Invoke、附加 Mac 視窗作為脈絡，以及與 Instagram、Facebook、Meta 廣告和 Google Workspace 的更深整合以提供商業洞察。
items_flat.analysis_en: The app moves Meta AI further into productivity and small-business tooling, competing more directly with desktop experiences from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google. Privacy implications of screen and message access will be a key adoption factor.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此 App 讓 Meta AI 進一步進入生產力與小企業工具領域，更直接與 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 的桌面體驗競爭。螢幕與訊息存取的隱私影響將是採用關鍵。

items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Teens
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched a version of ChatGPT designed specifically for teenagers, with age-appropriate safeguards and features aimed at schoolwork, daily questions and companionship use cases.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出專為青少年設計的 ChatGPT 版本，具備適齡安全措施，並針對課業、日常問題與陪伴使用情境設計功能。
items_flat.analysis_en: Targeting the first generation growing up with AI signals both product expansion and regulatory/parental pressure around youth safety. Success will depend on effective age verification and sustained safeguard performance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 鎖定與 AI 共同成長的第一代，同時反映產品擴張與青少年安全的監管／家長壓力。成敗取決於有效的年齡驗證與持續的安全防護表現。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands ChatGPT and Codex features including Computer History and Apple Messages
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴充 ChatGPT 與 Codex 功能，包含 Computer History 與 Apple Messages
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s August 20 release notes added the ability for Plus/Pro site owners to change ChatGPT-hosted URLs, Apple Messages plugin support on Apple-silicon Macs for reading/searching/sending messages (with approval), Computer History availability in EEA/UK/Switzerland for Pro users, and read-only Codex chat snapshots.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 8 月 20 日更新說明新增 Plus/Pro 網站擁有者可更改 ChatGPT 託管網址、Apple 矽晶 Mac 上的 Apple Messages 外掛（讀取／搜尋／發送訊息並需核准）、EEA／英國／瑞士 Pro 用戶可使用 Computer History，以及唯讀 Codex 聊天快照。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are incremental productivity and regional-compliance improvements rather than capability leaps. The Apple Messages and Computer History expansions deepen desktop integration while raising fresh privacy and consent questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些屬漸進式生產力與區域合規改進，而非能力躍升。Apple Messages 與 Computer History 的擴充加深了桌面整合，同時帶來新的隱私與同意問題。
items_flat.quote: Computer History in the Mac desktop app is now available to Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mac 桌面版 Computer History 現已對 EEA、英國與瑞士的 Pro、Business 與 Enterprise 用戶開放。

items_flat.title_en: Meta previews WildArtifactBench for evaluating multimodal agents
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 預覽用於評估多模態代理的 WildArtifactBench
items_flat.summary_en: Meta AI announced an internal evaluation framework called WildArtifactBench that uses win rates and Elo scores from human and agentic preference judges instead of strict ground-truth rubrics. It released 10 tasks covering complex real-world multimodal workflows and shared example artifacts.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta AI 宣布內部評估框架 WildArtifactBench，以人類與代理偏好評審的勝率與 Elo 分數取代嚴格的地面真相評分標準。釋出 10 個涵蓋複雜真實世界多模態工作流的任務，並分享範例產物。
items_flat.analysis_en: Preference-based agent evaluation is a practical response to the difficulty of scoring open-ended multimodal deliverables. Public release of only 10 tasks limits immediate industry benchmarking value, but the direction aligns with real-world utility measurement needs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以偏好為基礎的代理評估是回應開放式多模態產物難以評分的實務做法。僅公開 10 個任務限制了立即的產業基準價值，但方向符合真實效用測量需求。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re also previewing WildArtifactBench, an internal evaluation framework designed to assess agents on complex, real-world tasks across diverse deliverable formats.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們也預覽 WildArtifactBench，這是一個內部評估框架，旨在評估代理在複雜真實世界任務與多樣產物格式上的表現。

items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT 廣告擴展至歐洲多國
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced the expansion of ChatGPT Ads to 31 European countries including Germany, France, Spain, Italy and others. The move follows earlier testing of advertising inside ChatGPT.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布將 ChatGPT 廣告擴展至包含德國、法國、西班牙、義大利等 31 個歐洲國家。此舉延續稍早在 ChatGPT 內測試廣告的行動。
items_flat.analysis_en: Advertising remains a key monetization lever for consumer ChatGPT usage. European rollout tests regulatory and user acceptance under stricter privacy regimes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 廣告仍是消費級 ChatGPT 使用的重要變現槓桿。歐洲推出將測試在更嚴格隱私制度下的監管與用戶接受度。
